platform: macOS / Apple M4 / Metal / backing scale 1
build: cargo build -p lumapaint --release --features tauri/custom-protocol --offline --locked (embedded npm production UI)
qa_launcher: Own ad-hoc signed bundle jp.lumapaint.sceneqa; C wrapper sets two metric flags, redirects stderr and execs Release binary. codesign changes Mach-O signature bytes.
fixture: Reproducible synthetic 960x640 mixed scene: 600 rounded rectangles, English/Japanese/Simplified Chinese text, mask, Gaussian blur, 2 pixel tracks / 6 exposures. Not production artwork.

protocol.scope: native handler start to present API call; excludes OS input queue, GPU completion and physical display
protocol.operation: 3 cycles per trial: native magnifier 5 clicks in then 5 clicks out at window (492,343), 25% to 76.29% to 25%
protocol.warmup: one excluded complete zoom cycle after every toggle; initial font prewarm, viewport and reference buckets warmed before trial 1
protocol.pacing: CUA actual pointer clicks; ~16-18.5 seconds of operations per 30-click trial, not continuous pointer sampling; no sleep-based duration padding
protocol.comparison_limit: Same new Release binary on/off overhead comparison; not before/after change, not 60-second production-art acceptance. P95 nearest-rank per existing summarizer; inclusive host stages not additive.
